# Abhishekh Ojha

> Full-Stack & AI Systems Architect building production SaaS MVPs, scalable backend architectures, and AI agents for founders (0 → scale) using Next.js, Node.js, LangChain, TypeScript, and AWS.

Abhishekh Ojha is a Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in Indore, India with 3+ years of experience shipping end-to-end web products, secure payment and RBAC/ABAC systems, high-throughput data pipelines, and LLM-powered workflows.

## Selected Projects

- [We Won Academy](https://www.abhishekhojha.com/projects/we-won-academy): AI-driven college admission predictor and career guidance platform built with Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB.
- [AI Listing Generator](https://www.abhishekhojha.com/projects/ai-listing-generator): Automated SEO product listing generator powered by Next.js, TypeScript, and generative AI.
- [AI Lead Capture](https://www.abhishekhojha.com/projects/ai-lead-capture): Multi-channel automated lead capture and follow-up pipeline using n8n and webhooks.
- [RoomieQ](https://www.abhishekhojha.com/projects/roomieq): Full-stack MERN property and roommate discovery portal with location-based search.
- [Ministry of Steel](https://www.abhishekhojha.com/projects/ministry-of-steel): Accessibility, navigation, and web standards enhancements for the official Government of India portal.

## Core Stack & Specializations

- **Frontend:** Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Astro, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend & Databases:** Node.js, Express.js, Python, PHP, Laravel, MongoDB, MySQL, REST APIs, RBAC/ABAC Security
- **AI & Automation:** LangChain, AI Agents, Generative AI, OpenRouter API, n8n, Webhooks
- **Cloud & Integrations:** AWS (S3), Vercel, Docker, Git, Razorpay API
